rule: Feedback records research consequences, not automatic branch promotion.

branches.feedback: Treat H1 normal-code current-target execution as an architecture falsification surface during BASE; measure information gain versus duplicate-implementation drift.

Current target converges on one semantic organism: one final Clay binary, one local UnifiedDB semantic world, one local 4B, bounded ActiveAssembly, transient derived topology, peer semantic backflow and deterministic authority boundary. Old frankv0.1 structure is archaeology/regression evidence, not template.

Near-term priority moves from grammar invention to production selection/hashing and integrated typed-IR/evaluator/lowering closure. FRANK fixture pack must cover ActiveAssembly, authority, recurrence readouts, provenance/context/version, observer receipts and Retina/MVC state before handoff.

Old H-WP-01 freeze cannot be current release oracle after normal-code-first target redefinition. Re-freeze current architecture while preserving compatible historical schemas/tests. H-WP-02 is already claimed; do not duplicate it.
Preserve competition/broadcast/reentry causal stages, but keep adaptive recurrence controller OPEN. Require event-driven and fixed-recurrence baselines and separate focus from halting authority.

Observability is a candidate intervention. Future FRANK emergence/causal tests need common-snapshot instrumentation arms and paired trajectory identity; do not infer phenomenal consciousness from functional integration.
Preserve set-valued/conflict/context facets as representational semantics, but do not add a persistent service merely for the concept. Test whether simpler state/context representation suffices.

H1/H2 diagnostic topology remains derived/rebuildable. Provenance-family/context/version-aware slow promotion is OPEN and must beat simpler source-weight baselines before becoming durable topology policy. H3 should not require a separate persistent ClayGraph DB.

Prioritize one logical semantic identity plane with explicit epochs, transaction/replay identity and dependency-maintained views. Benchmark SQLite-like single-writer/snapshot/checkpoint failure modes on target Ubuntu before physical consolidation decisions.
